name: Unlabelled-PCA Five-Encoder Gated FiLM Hierarchical Network
summary: We fuse patient-pooled features from all five vision and vision-language pathology encoders with the six clinical variables. Within each training fold, per-encoder PCA subspaces are fitted on training plus 259 unlabelled patients, then integrated through learned encoder gating, clinical FiLM conditioning, and a hierarchical head separating coarse subtypes before resolving LumA versus LumB. Repeated nested cross-validation compares predictions against tuned clinical, simple logistic, and site-excluded baselines. A paired patient bootstrap interval decides whether H&E images improve PAM50 classification.
preprocessing: Pool all tiles across all slides of each patient into one patient-level mean feature vector per encoder (UNI2-h, CONCH-Z, Virchow2, MUSK, H-Optimus-1), keeping all data of a patient within the same split.

Inside each inner and outer training fold, one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 with an explicit missing/indeterminate level (capturing 31.8% indefinite her2) and standardize age using training-fold statistics (median-imputed if missing), identically across floor_clinical, simple_reference, and multimodal arms.

Inside each inner and outer training fold, standardize and fit 64-component whitened PCA independently for each of the five encoders using training-fold labelled patients combined with the 259 unlabelled patients (excluding unlabelled patients from the held-out site during site-held-out evaluation), without accessing evaluation-fold patients or labels.
Verify strict exclusion of RNA-derived variables and collection site from all model feature matrices.

training.convergence_check: Log per-fold training and inner-validation loss curves; verify trailing 5-epoch mean loss update is under 1% of total fold loss reduction before checkpoint adoption.

validation.tie_rule: Select on inner-fold validation macro-F1; prefer stronger regularisation or flat head when differences lie within 1 seed-ensemble standard error, and adopt complex model over fold-matched simple_reference on outer folds only when inner-fold macro-F1 exceeds simple_reference.
validation.site_sensitivity: 19-fold leave-one-site-out nested cross-validation grouped by site (site never used as predictor; held-out site excluded from unlabelled PCA pool), evaluating pooled out-of-site paired predictions across all 802 labelled patients.

metrics: Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) across repeated nested CV with 95% patient-level bootstrap confidence interval
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Per-class out-of-fold recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference on identical folds
Site-held-out paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) across the 19 collection sites
Per-fold trailing loss plateau convergence diagnostics
allowed_conclusions: Conclude 'improves' if the 95% patient-level bootstrap CI for paired macro-F1 difference lies strictly above 0, 'worse' if strictly below 0, and 'insufficient evidence' if it spans 0; inference is restricted to incremental patient-level PAM50 prediction over the six clinical covariates in this TCGA-BRCA cohort, contextualised by 19-site held-out sensitivity, without claiming standalone image utility, biological causality, or external generalisability.

diversity.data: clinical + all-five foundation-model patient-mean embeddings with unlabelled-augmented fold-PCA
diversity.model: clinical-FiLM modulated gated five-encoder network with hierarchical coarse-to-fine PAM50 head
diversity.method: semi-supervised fold-PCA + end-to-end FiLM conditioning + hierarchical LumA/LumB decomposition under nested CV

rationale: Unlabelled-augmented fold PCA compresses 7,424 dimensions safely (D3), while learned gating fuses visual and language-aligned encoders without selection multiplicity (D9). Clinical FiLM reweights morphology when HER2 is indefinite (D2), and hierarchical classification targets minority Her2 plus LumA versus LumB confusion (D1, D7).
